<!-- Generated by codeflower-app's cmd/gendocs: do not edit. -->

Download the latest release and replace this program with it, after checking the download against the release's SHA256SUMS. A "codeflower client" window or sandbox that is already running keeps the old version until you start it again.

A client older than the installed release is offered a restart, so its page is the new release's ("codeflower client restart"); --restart-client restarts it without asking, as in a batch job, unless it runs sandboxes it started from its page, which would stop. Sandboxes started in a terminal or a job keep running.

With --check, only say whether a newer release is out.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower update [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--check` |  | only check for a newer release, without installing it |
| `--config string` |  | config directory of the client to restart (or set $CODEFLOWER_CONFIG; default ~/.codeflower) |
| `--restart-client` |  | restart a running client older than the installed release without asking (not one running sandboxes it started) |
